tagline: Data analyst turning operational data into self-serve Power BI reporting with SQL, dbt and Snowflake
summary: Data analyst with 7 years of experience building the reporting and data models that operations and finance teams rely on. Cut weekly sales reporting from 6 hours to 45 minutes and introduced the first dbt star schema, giving finance and product one definition of active customer. Comfortable owning a problem end to end, from scoping with stakeholders to explaining results to non-technical leaders.

bullets.text: Cut weekly sales reporting from 6 hours to 45 minutes by rebuilding 12 Excel reports as one Power BI dashboard on SQL views in Snowflake.
Reduced failed nightly data loads from 9 a month to 1 by moving 14 ETL jobs from cron scripts to Airflow with retries and Slack alerting.
Lowered ad-hoc churn questions from finance from about 20 to 3 a week by publishing a data dictionary and FAQ for the churn model.
Introduced dimensional modelling with the company's first star schema in dbt, giving finance and product a single definition of active customer.
Automated the claims backlog report with Python and SQL Server jobs, moving it from weekly to daily delivery.
Identified £140k of duplicate supplier payments by building a matching query across 3 payment systems and reviewing exceptions with finance.
Cut monthly ticket analysis from 3 days to 4 hours with a Python tool that uses an LLM API to tag 4,000 public support tickets by theme.
